newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Quality Concrete to change year end.
newsitem.headline: Quality Concrete to change year end.

text.p: Quality Concrete Holdings Bhd said on Wednesday that it is proposing a change in its financial year end to January 31 from December 31.
It said in a statement that the change will allow it to have a "more efficient" tax payment system.

It also said it plans a restructuring exercise involving the transfer of Kutex Sdn Bhd to itself. Kutex is a wholly-owned unit of Quality Concrete Sdn Bhd, which in turn is a unit of Quality Concrete Holdings.
The transfer, which will involve a purchase price of 1.5 million ringgit, will allow "better reporting efficiency", Quality Concrete Holdings said.
Quality Concrete makes concrete and its subsidiary companies make and sell polypropylene bags and high density polyethylene pipes.
